title: Patristic quotes by-fast route has no direct regression coverage
reasoning: The owned change exposes the patristic-quotes/by-fast/<int:fast_id>/ endpoint, but none of the included context tests exercise patristic quote routing, URL reversing, status behavior, serialization, invalid fast_id handling, or church/user scoping for this route. The linked tests cover Armenian text scraping, Bible text fetching, devotionals, email tasks/templates, fast views, and feast admin icon actions, so a typo in this URL pattern or an accidental mapping to the wrong class would not be caught by the shown suite.
recommendation: Add a focused test for the named URL patristic-quotes-by-fast that creates a fast and associated quote data, calls the endpoint, and asserts the response status and returned quotes are limited to the requested fast. Include a negative case for an unrelated fast or nonexistent fast_id if that is part of the API contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests do not reference patristic-quotes, PatristicQuotesByFastView, or the patristic-quotes-by-fast route.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create hub/tests/test_patristic_quotes_api.py with an API client test for GET /api/patristic-quotes/by-fast/<fast_id>/ or reverse('patristic-quotes-by-fast', kwargs={'fast_id': fast.id}), asserting only quotes for that fast are returned.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level/API coverage for PatristicQuotesByFastView and its URL name.
